observations.finding: Presentation candidate returns before image decode when low8(a0)==0; nonzero path passes A:\JPG\Startup1.jpg into 0x802219e0. Caller ABI/policy remains unresolved.
Preview candidate handles a1 values 1 and 2 only; value zero returns without image presentation. Branch 1 uses Startup1.jpg; branch 2 uses B:\IMG00000.jpg.
Welcome menu confirm events write selected menu value into object-pointer *(0x80891ebc) byte +0x19; no safe standalone settings write API established.
Startup WAV path is passed to 0x8020926c with a1=0; returned handle stored at 0x809f0024.
Sound playback candidate gated by a0!=0, byte 0x80892144!=0, byte 0x8089185a==0, and audio-init byte 0x80897fba. Sets active byte 0x80897fbc and calls 0x802092b4.

stock_settings_status: Menu and zero-value skip behavior exist, but complete mapping from user choice to power-on presentation argument remains unresolved; no camera setting changed.
candidate_changes: Resource-only custom startup JPEG respecting resource boundaries and decoder compatibility
Route the verified no-presentation branch through a future validated welcome-policy setting
Keep startup sound optional through existing gates
limitations: No executable patch generated, no firmware repacked or installed.
Pointer-valued data and instruction pairs are static candidates, not proof of reachable code.
Removing JPEG branding is cosmetic; does not establish flash/RAM/latency gains.
Nikon EXIF, USB identity, filesystem and update model identifiers are compatibility data; not all occurrences are display branding.
200 and 500 scheduler-helper arguments found in menu flows are not measured boot delays or safe removal targets.
No recovery route or runtime memory layout is demonstrated.
